faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for MVH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 18 December 2026, and candidates report at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MVH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 9 vacancies: 2 Senior Resident (Radiology), 1 Senior Resident (Medicine), 2 Senior Resident (Anaesthesia), 1 Senior Resident (Peads.), 1 Senior Resident (O&G), 1 Senior Resident (Surgery) and 1 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for MVH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 18 December 2026 at 10:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 45 years for General, 50 years for SC/ST and 48 years for OBC (Delhi) Candidates (as on date of interview). Relaxation: SC/ST 50 years, OBC (Delhi) 48 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Basic of Rs. 67700 in Revised Pay Matrix 11 of 7th CPC & other allowances as admissible for Senior Resident (Radiology), Basic of Rs. 67700 in Revised Pay Matrix 11 of 7th CPC & other allowances as admissible for Senior Resident (Medicine), Basic of Rs. 67700 in Revised Pay Matrix 11 of 7th CPC & other allowances as admissible for Senior Resident (Anaesthesia), Basic of Rs. 67700 in Revised Pay Matrix 11 of 7th CPC & other allowances as admissible for Senior Resident (Peads.), Basic of Rs. 67700 in Revised Pay Matrix 11 of 7th CPC & other allowances as admissible for Senior Resident (O&G).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post Graduate Degree (MD/MS/DNB/DIPLOMA equivalent) in concerned specialty; if such candidates are not available, candidates with at least 02 years experience of Govt. Hospital/Govt. Institution in the concerned specialty will be considered. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open to Indian Nationals. Candidates must fulfil the eligibility criteria as per Residency Scheme.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview before the interview panel. Interview before the interview panel.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely adhoc basis for 89 days or till fresh/regular incumbents join, whichever is earlier. Candidates who completed three years Senior Residency: 89 days, extendable up to a maximum of one year only.
